decision: gate offloads test and bundle to the owner's instabox machine dof; no keep-alive
why: owner offered a 4vCPU/8GB box; workerd tests are the heaviest local load. An exec wakes an auto-paused box, and a keep-alive would only reach the free plan's 8 h run cap and its 5-20 min cooldown
evidence: forced gate: test 11.3s on box, 0.18s local CPU (was 9s); a deliberately failing test reports fail and exits 1; a broken sync fell back to local and passed
result: kept; key in ~/.config/xin/instabox.env (600), never synced, never in briefs; XIN_LIVE stays local

decision: subrequest risk: keep the 10x30 stress test in one invocation, no alarm slicing yet
why: spec 01 flagged the per-invocation subrequest cap as a risk to verify in M0
evidence: 10 conversations x 30 fetching tool calls pass in one runInDurableObject; a temporary 10x110 (1100 fetches) probe also passed locally in 18.8s
result: kept; local workerd does not enforce the production cap, so the deployed number is still unproven and noted in 01-host.md risks

decision: gate box pool: dof, xin-b2, xin-b3 run test/bundle in parallel with leases; 4th key unused
why: owner gave 3 more instabox keys. Free plan is 1 machine per account. The 4th account (machine t3dev) answers subscription_required, so it cannot run
evidence: 3 jobs submitted together ran on 3 boxes, 15s wall time; status showed two busy leases at once
result: kept; failing box benched 10 min then next box or local under flock; keys in ~/.config/xin/boxes.env (600)

decision: schemas use pi-schema builders + compile, not TypeBox Type
why: pi-ai 1.5.0 exports no Type; pi-schema is what pi-durable tools use and has no eval
evidence: grep of pi-ai index.d.ts; pi-schema dist has 0 'new Function'

decision: socket subscriptions are rewatched on wake, not only on the next sub
why: spec said lazily on first sub after wake, which would silently drop events for a hibernated tab that stays subscribed
evidence: Sockets.rehydrate runs at open from getWebSockets attachments

decision: failed ops store no receipt; ok and deterministic rejections do
why: a thrown op may be transient, so the retry must run again; rejections are pure functions of the frame
evidence: ops.test.ts: duplicate, eviction, rejections

decision: added POST /v1/cmd beside the socket cmd frame
why: the verify skill drives commands with curl, and the same Commands.run backs both
evidence: M1-commands-socket evidence under wrangler dev

decision: history.page op deferred to M2 with intake
why: it needs the message/turn model M2 defines; M1 has no product ops yet (BUNDLED is empty)
evidence: bundled.ts empty, test plugin proves the contract

decision: M1 written by the lead, not a worker
why: M1 is the contract every later lane imports (ids, ops, wire, plugin host); orchestration.md says shared types come from the lead
evidence: gate green, 16 tests

decision: worker cap 6 -> 24, worktree cap 2 -> 4; started M7, M9a, M8b-skills, M8b-mcp, live harness beside W3
why: owner said 20-30 subagents are fine now that heavy jobs run on 3 boxes; the dependency graph, not worker count, is the limit
evidence: 46 GB free locally; memory needs only notes/kv (migration v3), push needs only push_subs + sockets, skills/mcp are standalone modules
result: schedules wait for M2 enqueue; M5 waits for M2; M6/M9b wait for M5

decision: ops can throw OpRejected(bad_args|forbidden) for a stored, deterministic rejection
why: skills lane had to report malformed input as failed, which stores no receipt and reruns on retry; validation beyond the schema needs a rejection path
evidence: skills and ops proofs pass on the box pool after the change
result: kept; skills.put now answers bad_args; later lanes told to use OpRejected

decision: split M5 into M5a (workspace/thread docs, project ops, status machine) now and M5b (delegate_task, Anchor, Reporter, orchestrator tools) after M2
why: M5a needs no intake; starting it now shortens the critical path M2 -> M5 -> M6
evidence: src/workspace.ts stub + test/plugins/m5.ts slot added; lane spawned
result: M5b brief waits for the M2 report (enqueue API)

decision: batch user text is escaped inside <msg>
why: unescaped text could forge a <thread> report line in the coordinator's input
evidence: grep escape(body.text); gateway proof passes

decision: M2 lane stopped waiting on another lane's broken import; lead ran its proofs instead of re-briefing
why: the work was complete, only the shared test import was red, and M3 fixed it minutes later
evidence: gateway + dispatch proofs pass on the pool

decision: verify-xin KEK was 34 bytes; sealer requires 32
why: the throwaway key was never decoded until a module used the sealer
evidence: wrangler dev returned 500 KEK must be 32 bytes; fixed and redriven

decision: open: a batch with no resolvable model fails silently
why: spec 05 says ask the user to pick, never a silent fallback
evidence: wrangler dev: message.send accepted, no reply, no error entry

decision: M5a accepted: archived flag on projects, project id derived from command id, default threadLimit 8
why: 02-state omits archived; a derived id keeps create idempotent past the 24 h receipt TTL; spec names no limit
evidence: workspace proof rerun by lead after the lane's last async fix: pass
result: kept; 02-state to note archived at the M5 commit

decision: M5b started on M5a + M2 enqueue + M3 resolveModel; owns the xin.error entry for no-model and provider failures
why: closes the silent-batch gap seen under wrangler dev
evidence: lane spawned

decision: deterministic model op errors (unknown model, nothing to configure, bad custom api) are OpRejected bad_args
why: they were failed, which stores no receipt and reruns on retry
evidence: wrangler dev: unknown model ack; models proof passes after the change

decision: pi cannot compact a conversation whose only turn is oversized
why: selectCut has no cut candidate before the first entry; the lane reproduced it on MemoryStorage
evidence: models.test warms with one small turn, then the switch compacts before the next request
